tool_schemas.name: getNetworks
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of supported blockchain networks and their metadata, optionally filtered by operational status; results are returned for the requested page (0-based) with up to limit items. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if status is not one of active|maintenance|deprecated or if page/limit are invalid. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getNetworkDexes
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of DEXes available on the specified network, using page (0-based) and limit. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network id does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR if page/limit are invalid. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getTopPools
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of the top liquidity pools across all networks ordered by orderBy and sort, using page (0-based) and limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if orderBy/sort are not supported or if page/limit are invalid. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getNetworkPools
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of top liquidity pools within a given network ordered by orderBy and sort, using page (0-based) and limit. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network id does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR if orderBy/sort are not supported or if page/limit are invalid. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getDexPools
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of top liquidity pools for a specific DEX on a given network ordered by orderBy and sort, using page (0-based) and limit. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network does not exist or if the dex is not available on that network, and VALIDATION_ERROR if orderBy/sort are not supported or if page/limit are invalid. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getPoolDetails
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed metadata and current metrics for the specified pool on the given network; if inversed=true, price-related fields are returned from the inverted pair perspective. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network or poolAddress is unknown. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inversed is not a boolean or required identifiers are malformed, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

inversed.description: Whether to invert the price ratio

tool_schemas.name: getTokenDetails
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed metadata and current metrics for the specified token on the given network. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network or tokenAddress is unknown. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required identifiers are malformed, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getTokenPools
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of top liquidity pools for a token on a given network ordered by orderBy and sort; if address is provided, results are filtered to pools that also contain that additional token address. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network or tokenAddress is unknown, and VALIDATION_ERROR if orderBy/sort are not supported, if page/limit are invalid, or if address is malformed. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

address.description: Filter pools that contain this additional token address

tool_schemas.name: getPoolOHLCV
tool_schemas.description: Returns OHLCV candles for the specified pool over the requested time range at the given interval, up to limit points (max 366); if inversed=true, open/high/low/close prices are returned inverted. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network or poolAddress is unknown, and VALIDATION_ERROR if start/end cannot be parsed, if end is more than 1 year after start, if limit is out of range, or if interval is not supported. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

start.description: Start time for historical data (ISO-8601, yyyy-mm-dd, or Unix timestamp)

end.description: End time for historical data (max 1 year from start)

limit.description: Number of data points to retrieve (max 366) - adjust for different analysis needs

interval.description: Interval granularity for data resolution (1m for short-term analysis, 1h for intraday patterns, 24h for long-term trends)

inversed.description: Whether to invert the price ratio for alternative pair perspective (e.g., ETH/USDC vs USDC/ETH)

tool_schemas.name: getPoolTransactions
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated feed of transactions for the specified pool on the given network; pagination can be done by page/limit (0-based) or by providing cursor to continue from a prior position. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network or poolAddress is unknown, and VALIDATION_ERROR if page/limit are invalid or if cursor is malformed. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

cursor.description: Transaction ID used for cursor-based pagination

tool_schemas.name: search
tool_schemas.description: Searches indexed entities (tokens, liquidity pools, and DEXes) by the provided keyword or identifier (including contract/pool addresses) and returns a mixed set of best-matching results; results are not paged for this endpoint. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `query` is missing or empty, and RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED when request quotas are exceeded. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or lacks permission to access search.

query.description: Search term (e.g., "uniswap", "bitcoin", or a token address)

tool_schemas.name: getStats
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated ecosystem statistics computed from indexed DEX data, either globally or scoped to a single network (`network`) and/or a single DEX (`dex`). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `network`/`dex` are malformed or mutually inconsistent, NOT_FOUND if the specified network or DEX ID does not exist in the index, and RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED when request quotas are exceeded. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or lacks permission to access stats.

network.description: Optional network ID to scope stats to a single network (e.g., dxn_ethereum).

dex.description: Optional DEX ID to scope stats to a single DEX (e.g., dxd_01J...).

tool_schemas.name: getDexDetails
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed metadata for a specific DEX on the given network. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network does not exist or if the DEX is not available on that network. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

dex.description: DEX identifier (id or slug as returned by getNetworkDexes).

tool_schemas.name: getMe
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for this API key. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid credentials are provided, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

apiKey.description: DexPaprika API key presented by the caller (required when not provided via Authorization header).

metadata.name: DexPaprika
metadata.description: DexPaprika stores indexed DEX ecosystem data across multiple blockchain networks: networks, DEXes, tokens, liquidity pools, OHLCV candles, and pool transactions. The main workflows are (1) browsing ranked pools by network/DEX/token with pagination & ordering, (2) retrieving pool/token detail pages,
